issues.title: Missing GWT/Verifies for individual artifacts
issues.why: The module delegates all per-script logic to 79 separate files (01-*.md to 79-*.md) which are not provided in this context, leaving the actual tool logic unverified.
issues.fix: Explicitly list the delegation contract in §97 and provide at least one sample per-artifact spec file in the bundle.

issues.title: Incomplete Examples for Resilience Rules
issues.why: The 'Resilience — CI Edge Cases' section (R1-R5) defines complex behaviors (atomic writes, signal forwarding) but lacks code snippets or worked cases showing the implementation.
issues.fix: Add a 'Reference Implementations' section to §00 with a Python/Node snippet for the R1 atomic-write pattern.

issues.title: Ambiguous CODE_GLOB in Normative Contract
issues.why: The Normative Contract uses brace-expansion globs (e.g., {py,sh,cjs}) but doesn't explicitly state if these are exhaustive or if new extensions require a contract bump.
issues.fix: Add a note to the Contract block stating the extension list is exhaustive and requires a §98 entry to extend.
